El día 4/4 a las 9.00 de la mañana hice el cambio de aceite y filtro de mi auto Fiat Cronos, en la estación de servicio Ruta 202 y Avda de trabajo en Don Torcuato, resulta que cuando controlo el aceite, veo la tapa del compartimiento del filtro de aire levantado, y cuando quiero ajustarlo, los tornillos no ajustan, cuando lo llevo al mecánico me dice que al cerrar, ajustaron mal la tapa y al apretar los tornillos barrieron la rosca y ahora no ajusta la tapa. Volví a ypf boxes y me dijeron que se soluciona poniendo unos tornillos con tuerca, que me invitaron a ir a comprar, o  sea ustedes me rompen un auto con 30.000 mil kilómetros y yo lo tengo que solucionar?

(Translated by Google)
On April 4th at 9:00 AM, I had the oil and filter changed on my Fiat Cronos at the service station on Route 202 and Avenida de Trabajo in Don Torcuato. When I checked the oil, I noticed the air filter housing cover was raised, and when I tried to tighten it, the screws wouldn't close. When I took it to the mechanic, he said that when they closed it, they hadn't tightened the cover properly, and when they tightened the screws, they stripped the threads, so now the cover won't seal. I went back to YPF Boxes, and they told me it could be fixed by using some screws and nuts, which they suggested I go and buy. So, you guys can break a car with only 30,000 kilometers, and I'm supposed to fix it?
